noExistingKind: None of the kinds in checks/CONTRACT.md 'Loại mô hình' fits. retirement-6040: annual portfolio withdrawals. refinance-breakeven: amortizes a loan but compares two loans' payments/balances against a closing cost and zig-zag rate history; no house-price index, no LTV threshold. float-vs-fixed-replay: replays a short-rate index over loan windows (interest totals), no collateral value. lock-vs-roll-replay: compounding products of rates over horizons. fixed-cap-vs-index-growth: quarterly regional index growth vs a fixed nominal cap from one buy year; no loan, no monthly first-passage time. This topic needs a monthly first-passage time of balance / index-grown value across every purchase month, plus schedule thresholds.

newKindNeeds.inputs: (1) Monthly house price index, one row per month, no gaps (FRED HPIPONM226N: observation_date, value; NSA, Jan 1991=100). (2) Weekly 30-year fixed mortgage rate in percent (FRED MORTGAGE30US: observation_date, value). Params: downShare (0.10), termMonths (360), thresholds requestLtv (0.80), autoLtv (0.78), lenderLtvEarly (0.75), lookMonthsA (24), minFollowB (120), slowCutMonths (60); rule for the 'latest' rate month.
newKindNeeds.computation: Monthly rate R(m) = mean of the weekly rates dated in calendar month m. For a purchase month s with rate R(s): x = R/1200, loan L0 = 1 − downShare (fraction of price), level payment p = L0·x/(1 − (1+x)^−termMonths), scheduled balance B_k = L0(1+x)^k − p((1+x)^k − 1)/x. Scheduled months sched(R, t) = first k in 0..termMonths with B_k ≤ t (t = requestLtv, autoLtv), evaluated at the latest complete rate month. Index loan-to-value LTV(s,k) = B_k / (H[s+k]/H[s]). Set A = purchase months with a rate and at least lookMonthsA later index months: share with LTV(s,24) ≤ 0.80 and ≤ 0.75. Set B = purchase months with more than minFollowB later index months: T(s) = first k ≥ 0 with LTV(s,k) ≤ 0.80; report median, share T > slowCutMonths, max T and its month (earliest on ties), min T, and share T(s) ≤ sched(R(s), 0.80). Comparisons use ≤ with 1e-12 slack.
newKindNeeds.outputs: rate_month_latest, rate_latest, sched80_months_latest, sched78_months_latest; nA, firstA, lastA, shareA_ltv24_le80, shareA_ltv24_le75; nB, firstB, lastB, medianB_months_to80, minB_months_to80, maxB_months_to80, maxB_start, shareB_over60, shareB_le_sched80; per-purchase-month table {start, rate, sched80, sched78, ltv24, T}. Optional stated rule: midpoint (termMonths/2 = 180; ends month 181, 12 U.S.C. 4902(c)).
newKindNeeds.invariants: B_0 = L0 and B_termMonths = 0 (±1e-9); B_k strictly decreasing; sched(R,0.80) < sched(R,0.78) ≤ termMonths and both increase with R; LTV(s,0) = L0 = 0.90 > 0.80 so T(s) ≥ 1; T(s) ≤ sched(R(s),0.80) whenever H[s+k] ≥ H[s] for all k (prices never below purchase); share at ≤0.75 ≤ share at ≤0.80; multiplying H by a constant changes nothing; every T(s) in set B is observed (not censored); shares in [0,1]; nA ≥ nB, lastB < lastA.
newKindNeeds.dataNow: Index to 2026-07; rates to 2026-09-24 in the dossier pin (fresh FRED adds 2026-10-01: the latest *complete* month rule keeps 2026-09).
